entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's an absolute piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not faulty, it's just terribly designed! It's so hard to use. The menu system is completely confusing. I read the user manual twice and I still can't figure out how to customize the main screen.
I see. Yes, the customization features can take a little getting used to. If you go into the settings menu...

Stop! I don't want a tutorial. I've had it for over two weeks, and frankly, I expected more from a VeloFit product. Are you going to process my return or do I need to speak to a manager? I swear I will light you up on social media.
Okay, okay, I understand your frustration. There's no need for that. Let me just pull up your order information and check the return eligibility. Can I have your order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 16 days ago. Let me just check our returns policy...
Alright, I've confirmed it. Yes, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you.
Wait, really? Ninety days? So you'll take it back, no problem?

That's correct. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label and return instructions right now. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund in 3 to 5 business days.
Oh. Well, that's much better than I expected. Thank you, David. I appreciate you just taking care of it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
